item.title: ‘Innocent people don’t take guns to a protest’, insists man who spent three years insisting Kyle Rittenhouse did nothing wrong
item.description: A man who has dedicated an impressive chunk of his adult life to explaining why Kyle Rittenhouse was “basically Batman, legally speaking” has today confirmed that, actually, taking a legally-held gun to a protest is a clear sign you’re guilty of whatever happens next.

item.title: Boring man terrified by slightly less boring man
item.description: The boring man living at 10 Downing Street is terrified of being replaced by a slightly less boring man, it’s been revealed.

item.title: ‘Stop calling us Conservative Party’ says Nigel Farage wearing blue dress and Margaret Thatcher wig
item.description: Nigel Farage has denied Reform UK is becoming a carbon copy of the Conservative Party, though admitted it was perhaps the wrong day to cosplay as Margaret Thatcher.

item.title: Nigella to avoid Bake Off tent innuendo culture from the moment she opens the flaps
item.description: Straight-laced Nigella Lawson is set to replace outgoing host Prue Leith as Paul Hollywood’s sidekick on Channel 4’s long-running show The Great British Bake Off, and has insisted that she’s determined to clean up the show's reputation, which has become famous for its double-entendres and smutty one-liners.

item.title: World condemns Iranian regime after homeworkers face twentieth day without Internet
item.description: World leaders and various media outlets have condemned the sickening plight of Iran’s army of homeworkers who face yet another week of twiddling their thumbs.

item.title: The six funniest laugh-out-loud films of all time, according to me, Suella Braverman
item.description: During my time in government, I was often accused of laughing heartily at inappropriate things, such as the plight of the asylum seekers I was trying to send to Rwanda, but that is only because the left doesn't understand comedy.

item.title: Reform hopeful defection of tractor porn guy can be announced soon
item.description: The Reform Party is said to be hopeful that it will be able to announce the defection of the tractor porn guy in the coming days.

item.title: Trump finally comes out in support of gun control after learning people he doesn’t like also have guns
item.description: Donald Trump has publicly come out in support of gun control after the shooting of Alex Pretti in Minnesota, after finally learning that it's not just Republicans who are allowed to walk around with guns on their hip.

item.title: UK on verge of return to hedge-based porn access
item.description: Britain is preparing for a bold step back into the distant age of smut consumption after Pornhub confirmed new UK restrictions, prompting fears the nation may soon be forced to access pornography the way God intended: by accidentally discovering a ruined magazine in a hedge.

item.title: Man celebrates after successfully selling left kidney to pay for his daughter’s Harry Styles ticket
item.description: A man is celebrating today after successfully selling his left kidney in order to pay for a ticket for his daughter to see Harry Styles at Wembley.
